run_extractive_qa_training: run extractive question answering model training using a JSON training config file via the CLI
train_qa_model: train a question answering model from a config dict with dataset loading and HuggingFace Trainer
parse_qa_training_args: parse command line arguments to get the training config file path for QA training
push_qa_model_to_hub: push a trained extractive QA model and tokenizer to a private HuggingFace Hub repository
create_qa_model_card: create and save a model card README for a trained extractive question answering model
